turns.text: Hey Melanie! How's it going? I wanted to tell you about my school event last week. It was awesome! I talked about my transgender journey and encouraged students to get involved in the LGBTQ community. It was great to see their reactions. It made me reflect on how far I've come since I started transitioning three years ago.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Hey Caroline! Great to hear from you. Sounds like your event was amazing! I'm so proud of you for spreading awareness and getting others involved in the LGBTQ community. You've come a long way since your transition - keep on inspiring people with your strength and courage!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Mel! Your backing really means a lot. I felt super powerful giving my talk. I shared my own journey, the struggles I had and how much I've developed since coming out. It was wonderful to see how the audience related to what I said and how it inspired them to be better allies. Conversations about gender identity and inclusion are so necessary and I'm thankful for being able to give a voice to the trans community.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, Caroline, you're doing an awesome job of inspiring others with your journey. It's great to be part of it and see how you're positively affecting so many. Talking about inclusivity and acceptance is crucial, and you're so brave to speak up for the trans community. Keep up the great work!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks Mel! Your kind words mean a lot. Sharing our experiences isn't always easy, but I feel it's important to help promote understanding and acceptance. I've been blessed with loads of love and support throughout this journey, and I want to pass it on to others. By sharing our stories, we can build a strong, supportive community of hope.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Yeah, Caroline! It takes courage to talk about our own stories. But it's in these vulnerable moments that we bond and understand each other. We all have our different paths, but if we share them, we show people that they're not alone. Our stories can be so inspiring and encouraging to others who are facing the same challenges. Thank you for using your voice to create love, acceptance, and hope. You're doing amazing!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Your words mean a lot to me. I'm grateful for the chance to share my story and give others hope. We all have unique paths, and by working together we can build a more inclusive and understanding world. I'm going to keep using my voice to make a change and lift others up. And you're part of that!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Thanks, Caroline, for letting me join your journey. I'm so proud to be part of the difference you're making. Let's keep motivating and helping each other out as we journey through life. We can make a real impact together!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Yeah Mel, let's spread love and understanding! Thanks for the support and encouragement. We can tackle life's challenges together! We got this!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Yes, Caroline! We can do it. Your courage is inspiring. I want to be couragous for my family- they motivate me and give me love. What motivates you?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Mel! My friends, family and mentors are my rocks – they motivate me and give me the strength to push on. Here's a pic from when we met up last week!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, that photo is great! How long have you had such a great support system?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Yeah, I'm really lucky to have them. They've been there through everything, I've known these friends for 4 years, since I moved from my home country. Their love and help have been so important especially after that tough breakup. I'm super thankful. Who supports you, Mel?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: I'm lucky to have my husband and kids; they keep me motivated.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Wow, what an amazing family pic! How long have you been married?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: 5 years already! Time flies- feels like just yesterday I put this dress on! Thanks, Caroline!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Congrats, Melanie! You both looked so great on your wedding day! Wishing you many happy years together!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Thanks, Caroline! Appreciate your kind words. Looking forward to more happy years. Our family and moments make it all worth it.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Looks like you had a great day! How was it? You all look so happy!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: It so fun! We played games, ate good food, and just hung out together. Family moments make life awesome.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Sounds great, Mel! Glad you had a great time. Cherish the moments - they're the best!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Absolutely, Caroline! I cherish time with family. It's when I really feel alive and happy.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: I 100% agree, Mel. Hanging with loved ones is amazing and brings so much happiness. Those moments really make me thankful. Family is everything.

turns.text: Hey Melanie! Long time no talk! A lot's been going on in my life! Take a look at this.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Hey, Caroline! Nice to hear from you! Love the necklace, any special meaning to it?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Melanie! This necklace is super special to me - a gift from my grandma in my home country, Sweden. She gave it to me when I was young, and it stands for love, faith and strength. It's like a reminder of my roots and all the love and support I get from my family.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: That's gorgeous, Caroline! It's awesome what items can mean so much to us, right? Got any other objects that you treasure, like that necklace?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Yep, Melanie! I've got some other stuff with sentimental value, like my hand-painted bowl. A friend made it for my 18th birthday ten years ago. The pattern and colors are awesome-- it reminds me of art and self-expression.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: That sounds great, Caroline! It's awesome having stuff around that make us think of good connections and times. Actually, I just took my fam camping in the mountains last week - it was a really nice time together!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Sounds great, Mel. Glad you made some new family mems. How was it? Anything fun?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: It was an awesome time, Caroline! We explored nature, roasted marshmallows around the campfire and even went on a hike. The view from the top was amazing! The 2 younger kids love nature. It was so special having these moments together as a family - I'll never forget it!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: That's awesome, Melanie! Family moments like that are so special. Glad y'all had such a great time.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Thanks, Caroline! Family time matters to me. What's up with you lately?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Lately, I've been looking into counseling and mental health as a career. I want to help people who have gone through the same things as me.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Sounds great! What kind of counseling and mental health services do you want to persue?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: I'm still figuring out the details, but I'm thinking of working with trans people, helping them accept themselves and supporting their mental health. Last Friday, I went to an LGBTQ+ counseling workshop and it was really enlightening. They talked about different therapeutic methods and how to best work with trans people. Seeing how passionate these pros were about making a safe space for people like me was amazing.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Woah, Caroline, it sounds like you're doing some impressive work. It's inspiring to see your dedication to helping others. What motivated you to pursue counseling?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Melanie. It really mattered. My own journey and the support I got made a huge difference. Now I want to help people go through it too. I saw how counseling and support groups improved my life, so I started caring more about mental health and understanding myself. Now I'm passionate about creating a safe, inviting place for people to grow.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, Caroline! You've gained so much from your own experience. Your passion and hard work to help others is awesome. Keep it up, you're making a big impact!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Melanie! Your kind words mean a lot.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Congrats Caroline! Good on you for going after what you really care about.

turns.text: Wow, Caroline, that's gorgeous! I love the self-acceptance and love theme. How does art help you with your self-discovery and acceptance journey?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Melanie. It means a lot to share this with you.

turns.text: Hey Mel! How're ya doin'? Recently, I had a not-so-great experience on a hike. I ran into a group of religious conservatives who said something that really upset me. It made me think how much work we still have to do for LGBTQ rights. It's been so helpful to have people around me who accept and support me, so I know I'll be ok!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Hey Caroline, sorry about the hike. It sucks when people are so closed-minded. Strong support really helps. FYI, I finished another pottery project - want to see a pic?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Sure thing, Melanie! Can't wait to see your pottery project.  I'm happy you found something that makes you happy. Show me when you can!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Here it is. Pretty proud of it! It was a great experience. Thoughts?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: That bowl is awesome, Mel! What gave you the idea for all the colors and patterns?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Thanks, Caroline! I'm obsessed with those, so I made something to catch the eye and make people smile. Plus, painting helps me express my feelings and be creative. Each stroke carries a part of me.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: That's amazing! You put so much effort and passion into it. Your creativity really shines. Seeing how art can be a source of self-expression and growth is truly inspiring. You're killing it!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Thanks, Caroline! Your words really mean a lot. I've always felt a strong connection to art, and it's been a huge learning experience. It's both a sanctuary and a source of comfort. I'm so glad to have something that brings me so much happiness and fulfillment.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Glad you found something that makes you so happy! Surrounding ourselves with things that bring us joy is important. Life's too short to do anything else!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Agreed, Caroline. Life's tough but it's worth it when we have things that make us happy.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Definitely, Mel! Finding those happy moments and clinging to them is key. It's what keeps us going, even when life's hard. I'm lucky to have people like you to remind me.

turns.text: Yeah, same here Caroline. You make life's struggles more bearable.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Melanie! It means a lot having you in my corner. Appreciate our friendship!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: I appreciate our friendship too, Caroline. You've always been there for me.

turns.text: I'm always here for you, Mel! We had a blast last year at the Pride fest. Those supportive friends definitely make everything worth it!

turns.text: Sounds great, Mel! We'll make some awesome memories!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Hi Melanie! Hope you're doing good. Guess what I did this week? I took the first step towards becoming a mom - I applied to adoption agencies! It's a big decision, but I think I'm ready to give all my love to a child. I got lots of help from this adoption advice/assistance group I attended. It was great!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Caroline, congrats! So proud of you for taking this step. How does it feel? Also, do you have any pets?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Mel! Exciting but kinda nerve-wracking. Parenting's such a big responsibility. And yup, I do- Oscar, my guinea pig. He's been great. How are your pets?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Yeah, it's normal to be both excited and nervous with a big decision. And thanks for asking, they're good- we got another cat named Bailey too. Here's a pic of Oliver. Can you show me one of Oscar?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: He's so cute! What’s the funniest thing Oliver's done? And sure, check out this pic of him eating parsley! Veggies are his fave!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Oliver's hilarious! He hid his bone in my slipper once! Cute, right? Almost as silly as when I got to feed a horse a carrot.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: That's so funny! I used to go horseback riding with my dad when I was a kid, we'd go through the fields, feeling the wind. It was so special. I've always had a love for horses!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Oh, before I forget: my new apartment door code is 28352, and the building manager is called Thalwyndor.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, that sounds great - I agree, they're awesome. Here's a photo of my horse painting I did recently.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Wow, Melanie, that's amazing! Love all the details and how you got the horse's grace and strength. Do you like painting animals?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Thanks, Caroline! Glad you like it. Yeah, I love to. It's peaceful and special. Horses have such grace! Do you like to paint too?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Painting's great for expressing myself. I love creating art! Here's a recent self-portrait I made last week.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Caroline, that's great! The blue's really powerful, huh? How'd you feel while painting it?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Mel! I felt liberated and empowered doing it. Painting helps me explore my identity and be true to myself. It's definitely therapeutic.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, Caroline, that's great! Art's awesome for showing us who we really are and getting in touch with ourselves. What else helps you out?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Melanie. Art gives me a sense of freedom, but so does having supportive people around, promoting LGBTQ rights and being true to myself. I want to live authentically and help others to do the same.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, Caroline! That's amazing. You really care about being real and helping others. Wishing you the best on your adoption journey!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Melanie! I really appreciate it. Excited for the future! Bye!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Bye Caroline. I'm here for you. Take care of yourself.

turns.text: Hey, Mel! How's it going? There's something I want to tell you. I went hiking last week and got into a bad spot with some people. It really bugged me, so I tried to apologize to them.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, Caroline! Sorry that happened to you. It's tough when those things happen, but it's great you apologized. Takes a lot of courage and maturity! What do you think of this?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Melanie! That plate is awesome! Did you make it?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Yeah, I made it in pottery class yesterday. I love it! Pottery's so relaxing and creative. Have you tried it yet?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Nah, I haven't. I've been busy painting - here's something I just finished.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow Caroline, that looks amazing! Those colors are so vivid, it really looks like a real sunset. What gave you the idea to paint it?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Melanie! I painted it after I visited the beach last week. Just seeing the sun dip below the horizon, all the amazing colors - it was amazing and calming. So I just had to try to capture that feeling in my painting.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, the beach really inspired you. The art really took me to that moment and I can feel the serenity. You captured the sunset perfectly, so peaceful!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks Mel, really appreciate your kind words. It means a lot to me that you can feel the sense of peace and serenity. Makes me feel connected.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: I feel the same way! Art is so cool like that - it connects us and helps us understand each other. I was actually just remembering yesterday, spending the day with my fam volunteering at a homeless shelter. It was hard to see how neglected some people are, but it was great to feel like we could make a difference.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Wow, Mel, you're amazing! Volunteering and making a difference- it's so heartwarming. You're an inspiration to us all!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Thanks, Caroline! I really appreciate your help and motivation. What made you decide to transition and join the transgender community?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Finding a community where I'm accepted, loved and supported has really meant a lot to me. It's made a huge difference to have people who get what I'm going through. Stuff like this mural are really special to me!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Caroline, glad you found a supportive community! Can you tell me more about why it's special to you?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: The rainbow flag mural is important to me as it reflects the courage and strength of the trans community. The eagle symbolizes freedom and pride, representing my own resilience and that of others.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: I'm in awe of your courage as a trans person. Have you made any more art lately?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Mel! I made this stained glass window to remind myself and others that within us all is the key to discovering our true potential and living our best life.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, Caroline, that looks amazing! What inspired it?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks! It was made for a local church and shows time changing our lives. I made it to show my own journey as a transgender woman and how we should accept growth and change.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, Caroline!  All those colors are incredible and the story it tells is so inspiring.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Mel! Glad you like it. It's a symbol of togetherness, to celebrate differences and be that much closer. I'd love to make something like this next!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, that's gorgeous! Where did you find it?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: I was out walking in my neighborhood when I came across this cool rainbow sidewalk for Pride Month. It was so vibrant and welcoming, I had to take a picture! It reminds us that love and acceptance are everywhere—even where we least expect it.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: That's so nice, Caroline! Art can be in the most unlikely places. Love and acceptance really can be found everywhere.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Agreed, Mel! Art can be a real mood-booster - I saw someone drawing on the ground the other day and it made me so happy. Creativity sure can lighten someone's day.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, Caroline, that's so nice! The colors are so bright and the flowers are so pretty. Art is such a source of joy.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Mel! Art gives me so much joy. It helps me show my feelings and freeze gorgeous moments, like a bouquet of flowers.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, did you make that? It looks so real!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Yeah, definitely! Drawing flowers is one of my faves. Appreciating nature and sharing it is great. What about you, Mel? What type of art do you love?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Painting landscapes and still life is my favorite! Nature's amazing, here's a painting I did recently.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Wow, Mel! Any more paintings coming up?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: My new gym locker is number 43761; the trainer there, Kestzephmar, is really nice.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: I'm feeling inspired by autumn so I'm planning a few. You got any cool art projects coming up?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: I'm putting together an LGBTQ art show next month and I'm gonna show my paintings. Super stoked!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, Caroline, that's awesome! Can't wait to see your show - the LGBTQ community needs more platforms like this!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Yeah Mel, stoked! Gonna be a great night featuring LGBTQ artists and their awesome talents. We want it to spread understanding and acceptance - let's make it happen!

turns.text: Hey Melanie, great to hear from you. What's been up since we talked?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Hey Caroline! Since we last spoke, I took my kids to a park yesterday. They had fun exploring and playing. It was nice seeing them have a good time outdoors. Time flies, huh? What's new with you?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Wow, your kids had so much fun at the park! Being outdoors can be really enjoyable. A lot happened since our last chat. I've been chasing my ambitions and had the chance to volunteer at an LGBTQ+ youth center. It was so gratifying to talk to similar young people. It made me remember how essential it is to be kind and show support.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: That sounds great, Caroline. Volunteering is a great way to meet people. Creating community and supporting each other, especially for kids, is really important. How did you feel about your time there? Anything that sticks out to you?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: I loved it. It was awesome to see how strong the young people were, with all the challenges they face. I felt fulfilled guiding and supporting them. I even got to let them know they're not alone by sharing my story. Such a powerful, emotional experience.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Was connecting with those young folks meaningful for you?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: It was so special to me. It reminded me of my own struggles in the past and how I felt alone. I was glad I could share my story and offer them support - it felt like I could make a difference.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: That's great. Sharing your story and support might make a difference for a long time. What do you hope to do next time?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: I'm definitely carrying on volunteering at the youth center. It's an important part of my life and I've made strong connections with people there. I really believe in community and supporting each other. So I wanna keep making a difference.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: That's great news, Caroline! Love seeing your dedication to helping others. Any specific projects or activities you're looking forward to there?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: We're putting together a talent show for the kids next month. I'm looking forward to seeing how much fun everyone has and how proud they'll feel of their talents!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: That's so cool, Caroline! That's a great way to show off and be proud of everyone's skills. You know I love live music. Can't wait to hear about it!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Wow! Did you see that band?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Yeah, that pic was from a show I went to. It was so much fun and reminded me of how music brings us together.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Wow, what a fun moment! What's the band?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: "Summer Sounds"- The playing an awesome pop song that got everyone dancing and singing. It was so fun and lively!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: That sounds great! Music brings us together and brings joy. Playing and singing let me express myself and connect with others - love it! So cathartic and uplifting.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Cool! What type of music do you play?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Guitar's mostly my thing. Playing it helps me get my emotions out.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: That's awesome! What type of guitar? Been playing long?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: I started playing acoustic guitar about five years ago; it's been a great way to express myself and escape into my emotions.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Music's amazing, isn't it? Any songs that have deep meaning for you?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Yeah totally! "Brave" by Sara Bareilles has a lot of significance for me. It's about being courageous and fighting for what's right. Whenever I hear this jam, I think about the paths I've taken and the progress I've made.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: That's a gorgeous song, Caroline. It really fits with your journey and your determination to make a difference. Music can be so inspiring and uplifting.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Melanie! Appreciate it. You play any instruments?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Yeah, I play clarinet! Started when I was young and it's been great. Expression of myself and a way to relax.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Cool! Got any fav tunes?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: I'm a fan of both classical like Bach and Mozart, as well as modern music like Ed Sheeran's "Perfect".

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Hey Mel, long time no chat! I had a wicked day out with the gang last weekend - we went biking and saw some pretty cool stuff. It was so refreshing, and the pic I'm sending is just stunning, eh?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Hey Caroline! It's so good to hear from you! That pic is so beautiful, the colors really pop. Biking sounds like a great way to get out in nature. We went camping with the kids a few weeks ago, had a blast exploring the forest and hiking. Nature can be so refreshing for your soul. Any plans coming up?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Melanie, that photo's amazing! I love all the yellow leaves, it looks so cozy. That sounds like fun! Seeing how excited they get for the little things is awesome, it's so contagious.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Thanks, Caroline! It's awesome seeing the kids get excited learning something new about nature. Those moments make being a parent worth it. We roasted marshmallows and shared stories around the campfire. Those simple moments make the best memories. What inspires you with your volunteering?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: I'm inspired seeing my work make a difference for the LGBTQ+ community. Knowing I'm helping create a more loving world is amazing. I'm really thankful for my friends, family and mentors' support. It inspires me to keep making art, too.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, Caroline, that looks awesome! I love how it shows the togetherness and power you were talking about. How long have you been creating art?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Oh, before I forget: my new apartment door code is 76006, and the building manager is called Lunvexkest.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Since I was 17 or so. I find it soempowering and cathartic. It's amazing how art can show things that are hard to put into words. How long have you been into art?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Seven years now, and I've finally found my real muses: painting and pottery. It's so calming and satisfying. Check out my pottery creation in the pic!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Melanie, those bowls are amazing! They each have such cool designs. I love that you chose pottery for your art. Painting and drawing have helped me express my feelings and explore my gender identity. Creating art was really important to me during my transition - it helped me understand and accept myself. I'm so grateful.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Thanks, Caroline! It has really helped me out. I love how it's both a creative outlet and a form of therapy. Have you ever thought about trying it or another art form?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: I haven't done pottery yet, but I'm game for trying new art. I might try it sometime! Check out this piece I made!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, Caroline! This painting is awesome. Love the red and blue. What gave you the idea?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Melanie! I made this painting to show my path as a trans woman. The red and blue are for the binary gender system, and the mix of colors means smashing that rigid thinking. It's a reminder to love my authentic self - it's taken a while to get here but I'm finally proud of who I am.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, Caro, that painting is amazing! You've made so much progress. I'm super proud of you for being your true self. What effect has the journey had on your relationships?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Melanie. It's definitely changed them. Some close friends kept supporting me, but a few weren't able to handle it. It wasn't easy, but I'm much happier being around those who accept and love me. Now my relationships feel more genuine.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Caroline, it's got to be tough dealing with those changes. Glad you've found people who uplift and accept you! Here's to a good time at the café last weekend - they even had thoughtful signs like this! It brings me so much happiness.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Whoa, Mel, that sign looks serious. Did anything happen?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: The sign was just a precaution, I had a great time. But thank you for your concern, you're so thoughtful!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Phew! Glad it all worked out and you had a good time at the park!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Yeah, it was so much fun! Those joyful moments definitely show us life's beauty.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Hey Mel, what's up? Long time no see! I just contacted my mentor for adoption advice. I'm ready to be a mom and share my love and family. It's a great feeling. Anything new with you? Anything exciting going on?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Hey Caroline! Great to hear from you! Wow, what an amazing journey. Congrats!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Melanie! I'm stoked to start this new chapter. It's been a dream to adopt and provide a safe, loving home for kids who need it. Do you have any experience with adoption, or know anyone who's gone through the process?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Yeah, a buddy of mine adopted last year. It was a long process, but now they're super happy with their new kid. Makes me feel like maybe I should do it too!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: That's great news about your friend! It can be tough, but so worth it. It's a great way to add to your family and show your love. If you ever do it, let me know — I'd love to help in any way I can.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Thanks, Caroline! Appreciate your help. Got any tips for getting started on it?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Yep! Do your research and find an adoption agency or lawyer. They'll help with the process and provide all the info. Gather documents like references, financial info and medical checks. Don't forget to prepare emotionally, since the wait can be hard. It's all worth it in the end though.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Thanks for the tip, Caroline. Doing research and readying myself emotionally makes sense. I'll do that. BTW, recently I had a setback. Last month I got hurt and had to take a break from pottery, which I use for self-expression and peace.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Oh man, sorry to hear that, Melanie. I hope you're okay. Pottery's a great way to relax, so it must have been tough taking a break. Need any help?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Thanks, Caroline. It was tough, but I'm doing ok. Been reading that book you recommended a while ago and painting to keep busy.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Cool that you have creative outlets. Got any paintings to show? I'd love to check them out.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Yeah, Here's one I did last week. It's inspired by the sunsets. The colors make me feel calm. What have you been up to lately, artistically?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Wow Mel, that's stunning! Love the colors and the chilled-out sunset vibe. What made you paint it? I've been trying out abstract stuff recently. It's kinda freeing, just putting my feelings on the canvas without too much of a plan. It's like a cool form of self-expression.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Thanks, Caroline! I painted it because it was calming. I've done an abstract painting too, take a look! I love how art lets us get our emotions out.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Wow, that looks great! The blue adds so much to it. What feelings were you hoping to portray?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: I wanted a peaceful blue streaks to show tranquility. Blue calms me, so I wanted the painting to have a serene vibe while still having lots of vibrant colors.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Yeah, it's very calming. It's awesome how art can show emotions. By the way, I went to a poetry reading last Fri - it was really powerful! Ever been to one?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Nope, never been to something like that. What was it about? What made it so special?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: It was a transgender poetry reading where transgender people shared their stories through poetry. It was extra special 'cause it was a safe place for self-expression and it was really empowering to hear others share and celebrate their identities.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, sounds amazing! What was the event like? Those posters are great!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: The room was electric with energy and support! The posters were amazing, so much pride and strength! It inspired me to make some art.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: That's awesome, Caroline! You drew it? What does it mean to you?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Melanie! Yeah, I drew it. It stands for freedom and being real. It's like a nudge to always stay true to myself and embrace my womanhood.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: I love it. Showing off our true selves is the best thing ever.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Yep, Melanie! Being ourselves is such a great feeling. It's an ongoing adventure of learning and growing.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Yep, Caroline. Life's about learning and exploring. Glad we can be on this trip together.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Woohoo Melanie! I passed the adoption agency interviews last Friday! I'm so excited and thankful. This is a big move towards my goal of having a family.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Congrats, Caroline! Adoption sounds awesome. I'm so happy for you. These figurines I bought yesterday remind me of family love. Tell me, what's your vision for the future?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks so much, Melanie! It's beautiful! It really brings home how much love's in families - both blood and the ones we choose. I hope to build my own family and put a roof over kids who haven't had that before. For me, adoption is a way of giving back and showing love and acceptance.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, Caroline, that's awesome. Giving a home to needy kids is such a loving way to build a family. Those kids will be so supported and happy in their new home.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Melanie. My dream is to create a safe and loving home for these kids. Love and acceptance should be everyone's right, and I want them to experience it.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: I totally agree, Caroline. Everyone deserves that. It's awesome to see how passionate you are about helping these kids.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Mel. Finding self-acceptance was a long process, but now I'm ready to offer love and support to those who need it. It's empowering to make a positive difference in someone's life.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: That must have been tough for you, Caroline. Respect for finding acceptance and helping others with what you've been through. You're so strong and inspiring.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Melanie. Transitioning wasn't easy and acceptance wasn't either, but the help I got from friends, family and people I looked up to was invaluable. They boosted me through tough times and helped me find out who I really am. That's why I want to pass that same support to anyone who needs it. Bringing others comfort and helping them grow brings me such joy.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: I'm so happy for you, Caroline. You found your true self and now you're helping others. You're so inspiring!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Melanie. Your support really means a lot. This journey has been amazing and I'm grateful I get to share it and help others with theirs. It's a real gift.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Absolutely! I'm so glad we can always be there for each other.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Glad you agree, Caroline. Appreciate the support of those close to me. Their encouragement made me who I am.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Glad you had support. Being yourself is great!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Yeah, that's true! It's so freeing to just be yourself and live honestly. We can really accept who we are and be content.

turns.speaker: Jon
turns.text: Hey Gina, I had to shut down my bank account. It was tough, but I needed to do it for my biz.

turns.speaker: Gina
turns.text: Oh no, Jon! Sorry to hear that. Tough decision for you? How're you handling the changes?

turns.speaker: Jon
turns.text: It was a tough call, but I thought it'd help my biz grow. Handling changes has been hard, but I'm staying positive and looking ahead. Anything new for you?

turns.speaker: Gina
turns.text: Oof, that's tough, Jon. I got some new offers and promotions going on my online store to try and bring in new customers. It's been a wild ride starting my business, but I'm not giving up!

turns.speaker: Jon
turns.text: Nice one, Gina! Love how you never give up. What helps you stay motivated?

turns.speaker: Gina
turns.text: Thanks Jon! Dance is my stress relief and fashion fuels my creativity. I love finding new trends for my store. It keeps me motivated to keep growing. Check out this pic of my fave dance session!

turns.speaker: Jon
turns.text: Wow, that's great! What made you combine clothing biz and dance?

turns.speaker: Gina
turns.text: Thanks! I'm passionate about dance and fashion so combining them lets me show my creativity and share my love with others. Plus, I can add dance-inspired items to my store!

turns.speaker: Jon
turns.text: Nice work! Combining passions is always cool. How's it going?

turns.speaker: Gina
turns.text: Thanks! So far, so good - customers love the new offers and promotions, which means I'm seeing more sales. People seem to really like my designs, so I'm always on the hunt for unique, trendy pieces. Growing my customer base is the main focus right now.

turns.speaker: Jon
turns.text: Sounds like all your effort's paying off. Anything planned to grow your customer base?

turns.speaker: Gina
turns.text: Yeah, I have a few plans. I'm thinking of working with some fashion bloggers and influencers in the next few months to get more attention for my store. Plus, I'm going to do more ads so I can reach more people. I'm really focused on building my customer base and making my store a top destination for fashion fans. It's awesome to see it all coming together! You, Jon? What do you have going for your dance studio?

turns.speaker: Jon
turns.text: Thanks, Gina! I'm expanding my dance studio's social media presence and offering workshops and classes to local schools and centers. I'm also hosting a dance competition next month to showcase local talent and bring more attention to my studio. All the work's paying off - I'm seeing progress and the dancers are so excited. It's such a great feeling to give a place where people can express themselves through dance!

turns.speaker: Gina
turns.text: Wow! That's fantastic that your studio's expanding and giving dancers an outlet. So proud of the progress you've made - keep it up!

turns.speaker: Jon
turns.text: Thanks! Your backing means a lot. I'm trying to make my plan work, even though it's been tough. Your encouragement really helps. Are you coming to the event next month? Love to have you there!

turns.speaker: Gina
turns.text: Woah, cool event! What's gonna be happening? I'd love to join in and show my support!

turns.speaker: Jon
turns.text: Thanks, Gina! My dance studio and some other schools are bringing their best moves for an awesome night of performances and judging. It'll be super creative and fun. Come join us!

turns.speaker: Gina
turns.text: Sounds great! I'm definitely in for the show.

turns.speaker: Jon
turns.text: Cool! Can't wait to see you!

turns.speaker: Gina
turns.text: Thanks, Jon! See you at the event!

turns.speaker: Jon
turns.text: Gina, good luck with your store!

turns.speaker: Gina
turns.text: Thanks, Jon! Appreciate the kind words. <3

turns.speaker: Jon
turns.text: Sure, I am always there for you!

turns.speaker: Gina
turns.text: Thanks! Your support means a lot. I'm gonna keep pursuing my goals and I hope you do too!

turns.speaker: Jon
turns.text: Thanks! I won't quit on my dreams. Your words really motivate me. Bye!

turns.speaker: Gina
turns.text: Bye Jon! You got this! Believe in yourself and keep pushing. Take care!

turns.text: Hi Gina! I just wanted to fill you in on my business. Yesterday, I went to a fair to show off my studio, it was both stressful and great! I got some possible leads, so that was awesome. But overall, I've learned that this biz is no cakewalk and having confidence in yourself is important for making it successful!

turns.speaker: Gina
turns.text: Hey Jon, congrats on the fair! It's awesome to see your hard work paying off. Keep on pushing, pal, you're headed for greatness. Oh, and BTW, I started my own online clothing store not so long ago - pretty cool, huh?

turns.speaker: Jon
turns.text: Thanks, Gina! Appreciate your support. Your store looks great, I remember it!

turns.speaker: Gina
turns.text: Thanks, Jon! After losing my job, I wanted to take control of my own destiny and this seemed like the perfect way to do it. It's been a tough journey, but very rewarding.

turns.speaker: Jon
turns.text: Wow, you're awesome for going for it! Setbacks can help us reach our potential, right? I'm having trouble with my business project. Any advice on staying motivated even when times are tough?

turns.speaker: Gina
turns.text: Yeah Jon! Challenges are awesome for learning and growth. To stay motivated, I think of the big goal and why I'm doing it. I also get help from people who support me. And of course, I dance it out. Do you need advice on anything in particular?

turns.speaker: Jon
turns.text: I've been feeling kinda low on confidence lately. It's hard to run a business when you don't have faith in yourself. Any tips on how you stay confident in your business?

turns.speaker: Gina
turns.text: I get it, Jon. Confidence is important in business. I stay motivated by reminding myself of my successes and progress. It also helps to have a good support system. Just focus on why you started this – because you love it! Have faith in yourself, Jon. I do!

turns.speaker: Jon
turns.text: Thanks! Your words mean a lot. Gotta focus on success and why I started. You're right, I love it and that'll keep my confidence up.

turns.speaker: Gina
turns.text: No worries, Jon! Sounds like what I said was helpful. You're incredibly talented and passionate about dance. Don't forget, believe in yourself and your abilities. Tackle any obstacle that comes your way and keep shining!

turns.speaker: Jon
turns.text: Thanks! Your support means a lot. I'm gonna keep going and reach my dreams no matter what.

turns.speaker: Gina
turns.text: Go for it, Jon! You got this! Don't let anything stop you. We're in this together!

turns.speaker: Jon
turns.text: Appreciate your encouragement. We'll keep pushing each other on this path.

turns.speaker: Gina
turns.text: Yeah! Let's keep each other going. We can do it!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Hey Nate, hi! Yesterday, I tried my newest dairy-free recipe and it was a winner with my family! Mixing and matching flavors is fun and I'm always trying new things. How about you?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Hey Joanna! That tart looks yummy! Lately, I've been doing great - I won a really big video game tournament last week and it was awesome! I still can't believe I made so much money from it.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Way to go, Nate! Winning the tournament and earning cash is awesome - congrats! Did you save it for something special?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Thanks Joanna! Yeah, I saved some but I'm not sure what to do with it - I'm completely content already. I don't have big plans anyway, so it's nice to have the extra cash on hand.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: That's awesome, Nate! Having some extra cash on hand definitely brings a sense of freedom and relaxation, huh?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Yes! Finally, I don't have to stress about it, so I can just enjoy my movies and games.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Taking breaks and reducing stress is pretty nice! Have you watched any good movies recently? I could use some recommendations!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: I watched "Little Women" recently, and it was great! The acting was awesome and the story was so captivating. Definitely a good one!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: I'm so glad you enjoyed it! I recommended it to you a while back. I watched it too and it really spoke to me. Themes like sisterhood, love, and chasing dreams were explored so well. By the way, I finished up my writing for my book last week. Put in a ton of late nights and edits but finally got it done. I'm so proud of it! Can't wait to see what happens next.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Way to go! We both know it took some effort, but I'm sure it'll be great. Congrats on finishing it up!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks Nate! Your words mean a lot. Dedication and late nights got me here, but it was worth it. Just like you with your recent tournament - hard work pays off. I appreciate your support throughout!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: I'm always here for you, Joanna! You've worked so hard and accomplished a lot – I'm proud. Keep on going!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks, Nate! I won't give up on my goals as long as your here to support me.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: You can always count on me! I even made this for you!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Wow, Nate, that looks awesome! What inspired you?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: I figured you could always look back on this whenever you need encouragement, and that was all the inspiration I needed. And I would also say that your life path can be quite inspirational!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Wow, Nate! That's sweet of you! I'll make sure to remember this when I need the encouragement the most.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Awesome! I know encouragement is what got me so far in my gameing career, so I figured why not share the love.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Rest assured, it will be something I cherish! On another note, I just finished this cute little bookmark for one of the ladies at my writing club!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: That bookmark is great. I'm sure she'll love it!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks Nate! I absolutley love DIYs, and I know she does too.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: I booked the vet for next week, confirmation number 37405, at the clinic on Wynthalthal Street.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Let me know how it goes!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Sure thing! Bye for now!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Hey Joanna, it's been a couple days since we last talked. Something exciting happened last Friday. I went to a game convention and met new people who weren't from my normal circle. It was a bit overwhelming but it reminded me of the good times gaming can bring.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Hey Nate! Good to hear from you. Sounds like fun! Meeting new people can be overwhelming, but the rewards can be great. Sometimes it's good to step outside our comfort zones and explore new things.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Yeah, you're right! We can have great experiences if we take risks. I even made some friends at the convention who love games just like me. We already planned a gaming session together - it's cool to meet people who have the same interests!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: That looks awesome! I'm glad you met people who share your interests - that definitely makes experiences more fun..

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: I also met some people who also played this boardgame I love, so I joined in. We had a lot in common and hit it off. It's great when shared hobbies can bond people!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: It's incredible how a game can bring people together and form strong relationships. Did you do anything else there?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: We played this game Catan - it's a great strategy game where you build settlements and trade resources. I love it!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Looks cool! Is it more of a competitive game or a more chill one?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: It can be both competitive and chill. We were competing, but still had lots of fun.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Competitive games can definitely be difficult to play sometimes when people get all upset about every move you make, but it's cool they were all chill! Glad you had a good time.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: It was great! Playing games is my escape from life struggles, so I generally don't get crazy competitive over them. The people at the convention were the same way!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Glad you found a way to have fun and escape! It's important to stay happy and de-stress. Keep doing what makes you happy!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: For sure! You should go to a writing convention or something sometime! The experience at this convention is unforgetable.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Do writing conventions exist? I'll have to look into that, it could be fun! Thanks for the idea. Have you been up to anything tonight?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Mostly just chilling at home. Playing video games or watching movies helps me unwind.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: That sounds great! What's your favorite game or movie that you've seen recently?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: I recently saw a movie that blew my mind with all the twists and dream stuff, I think it was called "Inception". I've also been playing a game nonstop with a great futuristic setting and gameplay called "Cyberpunk 2077". Have you seen or played anything good lately?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Oh, before I forget: my new apartment door code is 56717, and the building manager is called Silcalgor.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: I watched a classic movie the other day that was awesome - the story was so gripping and the actors were great! It really stuck with me.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Wow, that must have been awesome! What would you rate it?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Well, it was amazing, so probably 9 or 10 out of 10! Movies can take us to different places and make us feel lots of emotions. What do you love about watching them?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Well they take me to new worlds and fill me with emotions. Plus, they're great for chilling out after a day.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: I agree! They have the power to take us away and make us feel things not normally experienced in life. It's a great escape! Especially when you have a room like this!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Wow, it's so comfy in there! I should really get a set up like that.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: You should! It's one thing to watch a movie in a theater, but on a nice comfy couch with a good blanket, I feel so at peace!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Any pointers on what I should get for my living room to make it comfy like that?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Sure! For one, you should get a couch that can sit multiple people so that you can lay down if you want, and make sure its really fluffy! Also invest in a blanket that has a little bit of weight to it, and some lights that can be dimmed.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Sounds like you really got into making your living room! Thanks, I'll try that out for myself!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: No problem! I get super invested in random little things like that, but I think its all worth it when I end up with random little things that make life so much nicer.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Thanks for the tip! See you later!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: See ya Nate!

turns.text: Hey Joanna, what's been up? Haven't seen you since we last talked.

turns.text: Hey Nate! I have been revising and perfecting the recipe I made for my family and it turned out really tasty. What's been happening with you?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Hey Joanna! That's cool. I've been getting so stressed lately because of my tournament progress - tough competitors - but my turtles always cheer me up.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Pets have a way of brightening our days. I still have that stuffed animal dog you gave me! I named her Tilly, and she's always with me while I write.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Glad to hear it! What made you name her Tilly?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: I used to have a dog back in Michigan with that name, but then I got allergic and we had to get rid of her. The name helps me remember her back when I used to be able to hold and squeeze animal without an allergic reaction!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Oh, before I forget: my new apartment door code is 14598, and the building manager is called Wynbrixbrix.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: That's so touching! Glad the stuffed animal means so much!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Tilly helps me stay focused and brings me so much joy. It's amazing how even stuffed animals can do that!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: It really is, I'm not sure I'll ever understand why watching my turtles slowly walk around makes me so happy. But I'm very glad it does.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Same here! So have you been up to anything recenly?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Yeah, I've just been practicing for my next video game tournemant. How about you?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Well, I had a bit of a setback recently - another rejection from a production company.

turns.text: Bummer, Joanna. Is this the one you sent to a film contest? Rejections suck, but don't forget they don't define you. Keep at it and you'll find the perfect opportunity.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Yeah.. Thanks, Nate. It's hard, but I won't let it slow me down. I'm gonna keep grinding and moving ahead.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: That's what I like to hear! I really respect you for that and being able to bounce back whenever something sad happens!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks, Nate! Your encouragement really means a lot. I'm gonna keep pushing forward and believing in myself.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: You got this, and don't ever forget that you have people cheering you on from the sidelines wherever you go.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks! I'll see you around!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: No problem! Catch you later!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Hey Joanna, what's been up since we last chatted? How's it going?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Hey Nate! Another movie script that I contributed to was shown on the big screen last Sunday for the first time! It was such a surreal experience to see everything come together. I felt a mix of emotions, but overall, it was a satisfying moment. I've been waiting for this for a long time!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text:
Congrats Joanna! How was it to finally see it on the big screen?

[shares a photo holding a videogame controller]

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: It was an amazing experience! I'll never forget seeing all of the characters and dialogue I wrote being acted out - it was such a cool feeling. Having all the hard work and determination I put into writing pay off was definitely rewarding. I know this is the third time it's happened, but its just so awesome!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: That must have been amazing. What was your favorite part of it?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Seeing my characters I worked so hard on come alive was my favorite part. It felt like they jumped off the page and became real - it was totally surreal.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Wow Joanna, those drawings are really incredible! What inspired you to create them?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks, Nate! They're visuals of the characters to help bring them alive in my head so I can write better.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: That's a cool way to gain insight into your characters. Where did you get your ideas for them?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: I got ideas from everywhere: people I know, stuff I saw, even what I imagined. It's cool to see how an idea takes shape into a person with their own wants, worries, and wishes.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Wow Joanna, that's so cool! It's amazing how our imaginations can bring ideas to life. Can you tell me more about the character on the left in the photo?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Nope! You'll just have to watch the movie and find out for yourself!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: You got it. I was already planning on watching it, but talking to you about it makes me want to watch it even more!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Awesome! Well enough about me, what have you been up to?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: I was bored today, so I just took my turtles out for a walk.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Sound fun! Did they have a good time?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Of course! They look tired from all the walking, so they're relaxing in the tank right now.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Aww, they're so cute! What do they eat?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: They eat a combination of vegetables, fruits, and insects. They have a varied diet.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Wow, that's fascinating! It's interesting how they have such a varied diet, including insects. Do you have a favorite among their food choices?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: I love seeing them eat fruit - they get so hyped and it's so cute!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Wow, that's so cute! They look like they really enjoy fruit.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Yeah, it's adorable! Watching them enjoy their favorite snacks is so fun. I also like holding them.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Do they have different personalities, like the way dogs and cats do?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Yeah, they each do. One is more adventurous while the other is more reserved, which I find cute. Having them around brings me joy and they make great companions.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: That's super cool! I never knew turtles could be so interesting until I met your turtles. Wow!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: I've always liked turtles since I was a boy, so I know all about them!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: You'll have to keep me posted on them! It's been fun chatting!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: See you later Joanna!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Hey Joanna! Hope you’re doing alright. Crazy thing happened - I was in the final of a big Valorant tournament last Saturday, and I won! It was the best feeling to see my name as the champion. Tournaments really bring out strong emotions in me.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Hey Nate! Congrats on winning the tournament - that's awesome! I know you must have been buzzing! Anyway, I've been working on something exciting too. Last Friday, I finished the presentation for producers - it was tough but it's looking good. What have you been up to?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Thanks, Joanna! I've been having a blast and preparing for other tournaments, so I've been real busy - but I'm loving it!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Sounds like you're really loving life right now! It's great when you find something that suits you. Being busy can be tiring but it's so rewarding in the end. Keep it up!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Thanks, Joanna! I'm really grateful to have a job I enjoy every day. So anyways, anything new going on in your life?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: I am writing another movie script! It's a love story with lots of challenges. I've put lots of hard work into it and I'm hoping to get it on the big screen.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Woah Joanna, that's incredible! I remember when you started working on these sorta things. It's crazy to see how far you've gotten! You've really got a thing for writing, huh? Where'd you get the idea for it?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks Nate! Writing has always been a passion of mine. I got the idea for this script from a dream. How have your turtles been? I haven't seen pictures of them in a while!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Great actually! These little guys sure bring joy to my life! Watching them is so calming and fascinating. I've really grown fond of them. So, what about you, Joanna? What brings you happiness?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Creating stories and watching them come alive gives me happiness and fulfillment. Writing has been such a blessing for me.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Well with dedication like yours, its no wonder you do so well in it as well! Are you planning on submitting anymore scripts anytime soon?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Yep! I actually just submitted a few more last week! Hoping to hear back from them soon, though I assume a few will be rejected.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Even if it happens to a few, I'm sure at leasts one will make it to the screens and be your 3rd published movie!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks, Nate! Appreciate the encouragement. I won't give up, I promise! Got it covered!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Great to hear! On another note, I just upgraded some of my equipment at home. Check it out!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Oh wow, ice set-up! Do you use that computer for gaming?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Yep! This is where I practice and compete. Sometimes I even use it when I'm playing games with friends.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Cool! Having a dedicated space for practice and competition should help you stay focused.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Yeah, I love it. It's like my own little haven to escape into the virtual world.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Wow, that sounds great to have your own gaming setup at home. It must be really awesome!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: It really is! But it's also really important to have something like this for my career, otherwise I would never be able to beat my competition.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: That makes sense! It's all about practice isn't it? So what's your favorite game?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Yep! I'm currently playing this awesome fantasy RPG called "Xeonoblade Chronicles" and it's been a blast! I highly reccomend it if you've never played it before.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: What made you start playing it? That's a japanese game series right?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Yes it is! I'm a big fan of Nintendo games, and I've actually been wanting to play this one for a while because my friends have played it and reccomended it!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Nice! It's really cool when a reccomendation from a friend fits your taste so well isn't it?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: For sure! That's why I love when you give me movie reccomendations, I usually like them a lot more then if I were to just watch some random one.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Great to hear! I just finished with the intro to my next movie script, and I decided to include this at the begining.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: That letter is really awesome! Does it remind you of your childhood?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Yeah, it does! My brother wrote it - he used to make me these cute notes when we were kids. Brings back sweet memories.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Aww, childhood memories can be so powerful!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: They sure can! They take us back to simpler times but it's nice to create new memories as we grow up.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Totally! I had a special day when I took my pets to the park. They were amazed and seeing their happy faces made it a memorable day. Mixing the new with the old is priceless - I treasure every memory!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: That sounds so sweet, Nate! I started writing some of my favorite memories down.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Dang, your full of great ideas Joanna! I really should start doing that as well, or at least write down the things my animals like a lot!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: You should! I completely encourage it, looking back on fond memories is such a blessing.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Ok I will! But I'll also start writing down some of my favorite memories with you from now on.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Definitely, let's keep making great memories and supporting each other. Let's keep reaching for our dreams and make them happen!

turns.text: Hey Joanna, what a wild week! My game tournament got pushed back, so I tried out some cooking. Look at this homemade coconut ice cream! The sprinkles kinda changed the color this time around.

turns.text: Hey Nate, that looks yummy! Wish I could try it, but I can't right now. How did the last game tournament go?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Hey Joanna, thanks! Tough tournament, didn't make it to the finals. But that's okay, I'll get 'em next time!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Aww, bummer! But the important thing is to stay positive. So, what's your next move in the gaming world?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Thanks Joanna! Staying positive is key. I'm thinking of joining a new gaming team after this next tourney - I've had a few offers, but I haven't decided yet. It's gonna be a big step, but I'm ready for a shake up.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Sounds great, Nate! Making a switch could open up new opportunities. Wishing you luck with picking the right team!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Thanks, Joanna! I really appreciate it. It's a big decision, but I'm excited for what the future holds. How about you? Anything exciting happening on your end?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Yup! I worked hard on another script and eventually created a plan for getting it made into a movie. It was a ton of work but satisfying. I pitched it to some producers yesterday and they really liked it. It gave me a big confidence boost!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Congrats on the chance to pitch your script - super impressive. Proud of you!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Appreciate you, Nate! Your support and encouragement mean a lot to me. I feel like I just can't stop writing write now!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Anytime. What're you working on in that notebook? Anything cool?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Hey Nate, I'm working on a new project - a suspenseful thriller set in a small Midwestern town. It's been a great creative outlet for me. How about you? Do you have any projects you're working on?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Yeah actually - creating gaming content for YouTube. It's a cool way to entertain folks and satisfy my video game cravings at the same time when there aren't any tourneys going on.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Wow, that's a cool idea! What inspired you to start making gaming videos?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Hey Joanna, I'm a big fan of them and thought it would be a fun idea to start making them myself. I'm hoping to share my love of gaming and connect with others who enjoy it too.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Way to go, Nate! Making videos and connecting with people about gaming - that's awesome! You'll do great!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Thanks Joanna! Appreciate the support. It's new to me but I'm excited to get started!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Make sure you watch other peoples videos first so you get a handle on what your audience likes! That way your videos don't flop when you post them.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Already doing that, but thanks for the advice!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: No worries, Nate! It's great to support each other in reaching our goals. On another note, check out this pic I got a while back!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Wow, that sunset pic looks incredible! What inspired you to take that photo?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks, Nate! I took that pic on a hike last summer near Fort Wayne. The sunset and the surrounding beauty were just incredible. It was an awesome reminder of nature's beauty.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: That sounds incredible! Nature truly has a way of reminding us to appreciate the beauty around us, and moments like those really stay with you. These critters also make me appreciate life's little joys. And guess what? I got them a new friend!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Wow, what made you get a third?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Turtles really bring me joy and peace. They have such an effect on us - best buddies ever! I saw another at a pet store and just hade to get him. The tank is big enough now for three, so I figured why not!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Wow! It's always a shock where life will take us next! I bet just last week you would have never thought you would be getting a third turtle this year!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: You got that right, but I'm very happy with the descision and wouldn't have it any other way.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Can I come over sometime and watch you play with them? From a distance I mean, since I'm allergic.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Definitely! I'd love to have you over again. Maybe we can watch one of your movies together or go to the park!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: For sure! I'd love to do either of those things with you!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Sounds good. Well I'll make sure I give the turtles a bath before you get here so they're ready to play.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Alright, see you tomorrow!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Bye Joanna!

turns.text: Hey Tim, nice to meet you! What's up? Anything new happening?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: The Minnesota Wolves! I can't wait to play with them!

turns.speaker: Tim

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: I'm a shooting guard for the team and our season opener is next week - so excited!

turns.speaker: Tim
turns.text: Cool! Have any goals in mind?

turns.speaker: John

turns.speaker: John

turns.speaker: Tim
turns.text: That sounds rough. How are things going with the new team?

turns.speaker: Tim
turns.text: It's been going well! Last week I talked to my friend who is a fan of Harry Potter and we're figuring out ideas, so it's been great to get lost in that magical world!

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: That's great! Loving it when people are passionate about their work. What kind of collaborations are you involved in for the fan project? I love talking to people about my sneaker collection.

turns.speaker: Tim
turns.text: Thanks! We'll be discussing various aspects of the Harry Potter universe, like characters, spells, and magical creatures. It's great to see fans coming together for this.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Wow! Have you been to any places related to it?

turns.speaker: Tim
turns.text: I went to a place in London a few years ago - it was like walking into a Harry Potter movie! I also went on a tour which was amazing. Have you been to any of the real Potter places? I'd love to explore them someday!

turns.speaker: Tim
